lokele: Liɛnɛsu lia Yesu Masiya, eliafaefaka Mungu Inde, mbo atambeke bɛkɔwa yande njasɔ ebisamboya la Inde lotoma bokitomo wande ndoluwesa liao ende bɔkɔwa wande ako Yoane,
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, 1:1 which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel 1:1 to his servant, John,

lokele: oyakambesaka lioi lia Mungu la likambesi lia Yesu Masiya, ko bitotina eyɛnɛk’inde.
english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

lokele: Limɛngɔ end’inde oyatotangelaka bato l’ende ebatokaka baoi ba litɔndɔli-li l’ebatolitekesa ebisosɔnɔmɔ nda liao; eoka mbile esamboya tina.
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

lokele: Yoane, ende bitanda osambale ebile nda yese ya Asia, Booto la lilatemi end’ino, eya Inde oyayali, la oyayalaka, la oyakayeke; la eya Belimo bosambale ebiyali oso wa kɛka yande,
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

lokele: la eya Yesu Masiya, Bokambesi wolendelomo la ewa oso ewatɛmwaka nda liwa la Bokakalesi wa Bɛkɔta ya wenda.
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

lokele: Ende Inde oyasosamak’iso la oyasɔɔnɔkɔlɔk’iso nda batwanelo basu ko la losendwo loa bakila bande angɛnɛ la oyasoyales’iso yakakaelo la botukä wa Kanga ebüchomu ende Mungu la Sango wande, tala la isosha bifomoko ngo ko end’Inde ko layalaya! Ongoma.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests Exodus 19:6 to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, atoya nda bafita la baiso batotina bɛlɛnɛk’Inde swaa, buu ko l’ebatumak’Inde likonga, tukela bitotina ya wenda elaleelak’Inde etondo; ngo ko anyo, ongoma.
english: Behold, 1:7 he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

lokele: Bɔkɔta Mungu asoonga mbo— Imi yende Alafa la Omega, litina mbo liako la losilo, oyayali, la oyayalaka la oyakayeke ako Ngɛnɛ wa Bofoka bototina. Liɛnɛsu eliɛnɛkɛ Yoane nda Patemo
english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega, 1:8 says the Lord God, 1:8 “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

lokele: Imi Yoane, boloo wanu la ɔmɔi oyasangani lanu nda bifembi la nda likakalesi la nda likɔkɔmɛlɛ lia Yesu Masiya, imi loyala oko nda bosanga ewatangomoko mbo Patemo loasɔ loa lioi lia Mungu la likambesi lia wɛndi wa Yesu Masiya.
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

lokele: Nda lise lia Ngɛnɛ, yakwaka nda Bolimo kwa nda efima, limɔ ombisa yami, imi loka limiki lifi kwa elia ifonge,
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

lokele: eliaongaka mbo— Sɔnɔkɔ nda lokasa ko yao ebikɛnɛk’aɛ la tomaka loao ende bitanda bosambale, nda Efeso, la nda Semuluna, la nda Pelagamona, la nda Tuateila, la nda Saladisi, la nda Filadelafia, la nda Laodikiya.
english: saying, 1:11 “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: 1:11 to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

lokele: Limɔ imi lokikwa mbo yɛnɛkɛ ngɛnɛ wa limiki eliaongaka lami, la akikwaka’mi, limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ bitalielo ya päka bosambale ebitulomu nda mbela,
english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

lokele: la atiteni ya bitalielo ya päka, imi lɔɛnɛ ɔmɔi oyɛnɛli kwa Wana wa Boto. Awataka kanju ko nda batindi la bɔkɔli wa mbela nda bokükü.
english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, Daniel 7:13 clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

lokele: Botö wande la swee biyali bifufu kwa fululu angɛnɛ, bifufu kwa basasɛ ba mbula la baiso bande bayali kwa bösä wa loiloi,
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

lokele: la batindi bande bayali kwa bosongo ebosofufolomo ani bosotalangolomo la bösä, la limiki liande liyali kwa elundi ya tolimo;
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

lokele: la nda bosamba wa olome, inde lounda tolonge osambale la ambɔtɛ wa fänga imbale ebiötu lokuswa nda bɔnɔkɔ wande, la bɔmbɔ wande kwa liso lia use, ani liao lisoanganga nda efanga ya löwa.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ’mi wɛnɛ Inde, imi lokwa se nda batindi bande, kwa mbo isowa; Inde lotaliela’mi bosamba wande wa olome, Inde loonga mbo— Owangëke, Imi yende ewa oso, l’ewa mbisa,
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

lokele: la Oyakoyali la loiko; yawäkä, nde tɛnɛngo, ikoyali la loiko loa layalaya la isounda fungola ya liwa la eya Ewelo.
english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades. 1:18

lokele: Eokao sɔnɔkɔ njasɔ ebisɔɛn’aɛ, la yao ebiyali la ebikayeke mbisa.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

lokele: Feu ya loasɔ loa tolonge bosambale etwɛniki aɛ nda bosamba wami wa olome la bitalielo bosambale ya päka ya mbela, ambo tolonge bosambale twende bakitomo ba bitanda bosambale, la bitalielo ya päka bosambale yende bitanda bosambale angɛnɛ.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels 1:20 of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.

lokele: Ende bokitomo ako Botingani wa Etanda nda Efeso, sɔnɔkɔ mbo— Inde oyaundi tolonge bosambale nda bosamba wande wa olome, oyatokɛndɛkɛndɛ atiteni ya bitalielo ya päka bosambale, Inde nd’aongi mbo—
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

lokele: Iluwi nde bekeeli yaɛ la bonui wa likuwa liaɛ la likɔkɔmɛlɛ liaɛ, la mbo botikɔkɔlɛ ndwɛnɛ bato babe nde osokotela ebasoonga mbo bende batomomu ani bat’iyo la osotombol’iyo mbo bende la lolanga.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

lokele: Iluwi imɔ mbo osokɔkɔmɔ la bofiili la osotendela ebiwau ko l’eoka ya lina liami, angotatɛkwa bonui.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have 2:3 not grown weary.

lokele: Kongo ko, yende l’aɛ la loasɔ-lo, loko mbo osotamacha losamɔ loaɛ loa oso.
english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

lokele: Eokao, enyekelaka olo asokwel’aɛ se la kalanganaka la kelaka bekeeli eyakelak’aɛ ko oso. Nde otikele ongoma, ani yeyaka end’aɛ la yesukolaka etalielo ya päka yaɛ nda elela ya yao, sakolo ngo ko osokalangana.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

lokele: Kongo ko, wende la loasɔ-lo lolau, loko mbo osoiyela bekeeli y’eba Nikolaita, ebisoiyel’imɔ ko Imi wiyela yao.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

lokele: Inde oyayali la litoi, okeke yao ebitoonga Bolimo la bitanda. Yefaefak’inde oyatolonga, isosha sholaka tuma twa isandu sha loiko, esisoyala nda Paladiso ya Mungu. Wɛndi ende Etanda nda Semuluna
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

lokele: La ende bokitomo ako Botingani wa Etanda nda Semuluna, sɔnɔkɔ mbo— Ewa oso, l’Ewa mbisa, oyawaka la oyauwaka liasi la loiko, Inde nd’aongi mbo—
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

lokele: Iluwi nde bifembi yaɛ la mbuwa yaɛ, ani wewe wende lifoka, la limɔli elisomɔlɔkɔmɔ ino ko l’ebasoonga mbo bende BaYuda, ani bati BaYuda, kangä ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ya Satana.
english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

lokele: Owangëke to biale ebisambokesomo aɛ; tɛnɛ Bowanjeli ako Satana, asambokusha bamɔi banu nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ mbo okotelomoko, limɔ botokaka bifembi ko bacho liu. Nde kɔkɔmɔkɔ nda lilendelu ko nda liwa limɔ yefaefak’aɛ iyoyo sha loiko.
english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

lokele: Inde oyayali la litoi okeke yao ebitoonga Bolimo la bitanda. Inde oyatolonga atiokesomoko wale wa liwa lia ambale. Wɛndi ende Etanda nda Pelagamona
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

lokele: La ende bokitomo ako Botingani wa Etanda nda Pelagamona, sɔnɔkɔ mbo— Inde oyaundaka ambɔtɛ wa fänga imbale ebiötu, Inde nd’aongi mbo—
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

lokele: Iluwi nde olo ayali aɛ, ko olo ayali kɛka ya Satana; nde osokusamela lina liami ngwi la otiangane lilendelu liami ango nda mbile ya Antipa, boaoleli wami wa lilendelu, oyaolomoko sisi yanu, olo ayali Satana.
english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

lokele: Kongo ko yende laɛ la njasɔ bimyɔ, mbo wende la bamɔi omao ebasoimela liekesi lia Balaama oyaekesaka Balaka ndosɛlɛ litalɛ liokwesa bana ba Isalaele tolango mbo baleke bieka ebitambomu ende bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu la mbo bakeleke bolëfë.
english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

lokele: Ongoma aɛ wende imɔ l’ebasoimela liekesi lia eba Nikolaita;
english: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans. 2:15

lokele: eokao kalanganaka, eya to mbo otikalangane, ani itoya end’aɛ lisasaya, la itonanaka la bato ana la ambɔtɛ wa bɔnɔkɔ wami.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

lokele: Inde oyayali la litoi, okeke yao ebitoonga Bolimo la bitanda! Yefaefak’inde oyatolonga ngo ko isosha sholaka Mana ebisoisama, la itofaef’inde itaatalɛ sifufu esitomu la lina liyai elitiluwe boto angɔmɔi, sakolo ko inde oyatɔɔlɔ liao. Wɛndi ende Etanda nda Tuateila
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, 2:17 and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

lokele: La ende bokitomo ako Botingani wa Etanda nda Tuateila, sɔnɔkɔ mbo— Wana wa Mungu oyayali la baiso kwa bösä wa loiloi la batindi kwa bosongo ebosofufolomo, Inde nd’aongi mbo—
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

lokele: Iluwi nde bekeeli yaɛ la losamɔ loaɛ la liimeli liaɛ la lisungi liaɛ la likɔkɔmɛlɛ liaɛ la mbo bekeeli yaɛ ya mbisa bisolongela eya oso.
english: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

lokele: Kongo ko yende laɛ la loasɔ-lo, loko mbo osomacha botomali ona ako Yesabele oyatangi nde mbo ale bɔtɔndɔli, mbo ekeseke bato, la mbo alimbeke bɛkɔwa yami bachweke bolëfë la baleke bieka ebitambomu ende bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu.
english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your 2:20 woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

lokele: Yafaefak’inde fofe mbo akalanganeke loasɔ loa nyongo yande, nde atilɛmbɛkɛ ndokalangana.
english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

lokele: Toka kɔni, itoinges’inde nda tange la loo amamwito l’ebatochwaka lande nyongo ko nda bifembi ya likama, sakolo ko batokalangana bekeeli yau;
english: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

lokele: la yolaka bana bande la liömä lifi. Limɔ bitanda bitotina beluwaka nde mbo Imi yende Inde oyasotichaka baenyeli la betema ya bato la yefaefaka boto la boto wanu liɔli lioengana la bekeeli yanu.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

lokele: Kongo ko isoonga lanu ebamɔi nda Tuateila ebatiimele liekesi-li, ebatiluwe njasɔ ebisotangomo la bamɔi mbo njasɔ ya Satana ebiisomu mbii, imi mbo iitotaliel’ino bolito wasi,
english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

lokele: nde takuamelaka ko yao ebiimel’ino, ko nd’akayeke Imi.
english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

lokele: La end’inde oyatolonga la oyatolitesa bekeeli yami ko nda liko, yefaefak’inde isosha shokakalesa tukela ya wenda,
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

lokele: la atokakales’iyo la isosola sha yeto la atoataka iyo kwa tei ya tɔlɔngɔ, ani asɔɔlɔ imɔ ko Imi, isosha ende Sango wami,
english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, Psalms 2:9 as I also have received of my Father;

lokele: la yefaefak’inde ilonge sha lisɔi.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

lokele: Inde oyayali la litoi, okeke yao ebitoonga Bolimo la bitanda!
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

lokele: Ende bokitomo ako Botingani wa Etanda nda Saladisi, sɔnɔkɔ mbo— Inde oyayali la Balimo bosambale ya Mungu la tolonge bosambale, Inde nd’aongi mbo— Iluwi nde bekeeli yaɛ; osotangomo mbo wende la liwawi, kongo ko osowa.
english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

lokele: Lambaka to, la kɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ ebitikali ebisambowa eoka itiɛnɛ bekeeli yaɛ mbo bisɔɔlwa nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, 3:2 for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

lokele: Eokao enyelaka yao ebisoimel’aɛ la ebisokak’aɛ, litesaka yao la kalanganaka. Nde eya mbo otilambe, ani yeyaka end’aɛ kwa atoya wiya limɔ oitoluwa mbile eyekayeke lami end’aɛ.
english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

lokele: Nde okoyali nde la bamyɔ nda Saladisi ebatibebese bisinda yau la bɛkɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ amamwito lami ko la bisinda bifufu, eoka bengani nde.
english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

lokele: Inde oyatolonga, ewatesomoko ongoma la bisinda bifufu, la itiafanjeke lina liande nda lokasa loa loiko, nde yeaolaka lina liande oso wa Sango wami la oso wa bakitomo bande.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

lokele: Inde oyayali la litoi, okeke yao ebitoonga Bolimo la bitanda! Wɛndi ende Etanda nda Filadelafia
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

lokele: Ende bokitomo ako Botingani wa Etanda nda Filadelafia, sɔnɔkɔ mbo— Inde oyayali Botanu la wewe, ako Inde oyayali la lofungola loa Dawidi, la oyatoliola, angwɛnɛ boto atolia; la oyatolia, angwɛnɛ boto atoliola, Inde nd’aongi mbo—
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

lokele: Iluwi nde bekeeli yaɛ, tɛnɛ ngo, oso waɛ isota bome eboliolomu nde, angwɛnɛ boto angɔmɔi kokɔkɔlɔ ndoliaka wao; iluwi imɔ mbo wende ko la bofoka sinyo kongo, nde osolitesa lioi liami la otianganye lina liami.
english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, itofaef’ino eba ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ya Satana ebasoonga mbo bende BaYuda, ani bati bau, nde bale la lolanga; tɛnɛ ngo, itoiyes’iyo mbo bayeke oyatulama se oso wa batindi baɛ, la mbo baluweke fololo mbo isosama aɛ.
english: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

lokele: Eoka osokɔchaka lioi liami lia likɔkɔmɛlɛ, Imi imɔ yetinganaka laɛ nda mbile ya likoteli elisamboya ende bato ba wenda bototina ndoyakotela ebasoyala ono se.
english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

lokele: Itoya lisasaya, takuamelaka to yao ebile laɛ, mbo boto ataɔnɔkɔlɔ iyoyo shaɛ sha loiko.
english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

lokele: Inde oyatolonga, itosɛl’inde likole nda ndakɔ ya Mungu wami, la atilasekwek’imɔ omao la yelasɔnɔkɔ end’inde lina lia Mungu wami, la lina lia bokenge wa Mungu wami, boko Yelusaleme eyai ebotosulwa se nda Use ko ende Mungu wami, la lina eliyai liami angɛnɛ.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

lokele: Inde oyayali la litoi, okeke yao ebitoonga Bolimo la bitanda! Wɛndi ende Etanda nda Laodikiya
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

lokele: Ende bokitomo ako Botingani wa Etanda nda Laodikiya, sɔnɔkɔ mbo— Inde oyayali la lina liko Ongoma, ako Bokambesi wolendelomu la Liako lia eyakelomoko la Mungu, Inde nd’aongi mbo—
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning 3:14 of God’s creation, says these things:

lokele: Iluwi nde bekeeli yaɛ, mbo oti la bondiya, oti l’etao; ani imi kolɛmbɛ mbo oyaleke kwa la bondiya, kwa la etao.
english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

lokele: Nde ongoma, eoka wende la lotatambe, inga la bondiya inga l’etao, isambosɛndɛk’aɛ nda bɔnɔkɔ wami.
english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

lokele: Eoka mbo osoonga mbo— Imi yende lifoka la isosɔnja bieto la it’imɔ la boeno wa yeka, la eoka otiluwe mbo osowɛlɔmɔ ngandi ako aɛ, boto wa mbuwa l’iuwe, la botuku, la wase.
english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

lokele: Eokao isofumbes’aɛ mbo oyek’ende Imi oyasomba mbela ebisotanesomo la bösä mbo ofoteke wewe, la ndoyasomba bisinda bifufu yowataka la wɛli mbo sɔni ya wase ebole laɛ botɛnɛlɛ la ndoyasomba lisoo lia baiso, liolɔkɔ nda baiso baɛ mbo wɛnɛkɛ la wɛli.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

lokele: Imi isoimaka la isokucha ebatosamaka’mi osam’iyo; eokao yalaka la bofiili la kalanganaka.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, isoemala nda bome la isotitaka bome kɔkɔkɔ; eyambo boto eoka limiki liami, la eliola bome, ani yɛɔtɔkɔ end’inde la yelaka lande bieka, la inde elaka amamwito lami.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

lokele: Inde oyatolonga, itofaefak’inde isosha shoyala se amamwito lami nda kɛka yami, kwa alongaka’mi angɛnɛ la kwa ayalaka’mi se amamwito la Sango wami nda kɛka yande.
english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

lokele: Inde oyayali la litoi, okeke yao ebitoonga Bolimo la bitanda!
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

lokele: Mbisa ya njasɔ-bi, imi loticha la tɛnɛ, bome loliolomo nda Use, la limiki lia oso eliokaka’mi ani lisoonga lami kwa ifonge, liao loonga lami liasi mbo— Lilaka ono la itɔɛnɛs’aɛ yao ebiondu ndoya ko mbisa.
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

lokele: Lisasaya imi lokayalake la Bolimo, limɔ tɛnɛ ngo, kɛka lotomo nda Use la boto ayali se nda yao!
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

lokele: La Inde oyayali se omao, lokwelo bɔfɔnɔ wa lisasɛ lia bɔfɛkɔ liko jaspe la kwa lisasɛ liko sardoine la bonama lolingela kɛka ewɛnɛli kwa bɔfɔnɔ wa lisasɛ lia ikɛikɛli.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

lokele: La kɛka yasi litinda la inɛi lolingela kɛka efi la biange litinda la inɛi loyala se nda kɛka ina, bawataka bisinda bifufu la nda betö yau toyoyo twa mbela.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

lokele: Limɔ tobalibali la bamiki bafi la bilundi ya kaki lokuswakuswa nda kɛka efi la päka osambale ya bösä loana oso wa kɛka efi, bile balimo osambale ya Mungu,
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

lokele: la oso wa kɛka efi loyala eliya ewɛnɛli kwa talatala ya wɛ̈li. La ebayali la liwawi banɛi lolingelaka kɛka efi la fangi la fangi, iyo lotuma la baiso, la oso la mbisa;
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

lokele: ewa oso wa liwawi loyala kwa simba, l’ewa ambale kwa mbolo, l’ewa asatɔ loyala la bɔmbɔ kwa ewa boto, l’ewa anɛi loyala kwa elöngö eyetoungwaka.
english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

lokele: Ebayali la liwawi banɛi loyala ɔmɔi l’ɔmɔi la bafafu liambɛ, iyo lotuma la baiso atiteni la fangi bitotina, la löwa la ocho angotatɛkwa ndoongaka mbo— Botanu, Botanu, Botanu, Ngɛnɛ Mungu wa Bofoka bototina, oyayali, la oyayalaka la oyakayeke!
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy 4:8 is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

lokele: La atofaekefa eba liwawi efaef’Inde oyayali se nda kɛka la oyayali la liwawi lia layalaya, ko tala la lilitesi la kelekele,
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

lokele: limɔ biange litinda la anɛi batotulakamel’Inde se oyayali nda kɛka efi la oyayali la liwawi ko layalaya, l’ani batokusha toyoyo twau se oso wa kɛka efi, iyo batoonga mbo—
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

lokele: Ngɛnɛ Mungu wasu, Aɛ oondu nde ndɔɔlɔ tala la lilitesi la bofoka, eoka Aɛ nd’akelaka bitotina ebiyali la yakelomoko ko l’eoka ya lisangi liaɛ.
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, 4:11 to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

lokele: Limɔ yɛnɛkɛ nda lingasa lia bosamba w’olome wa Inde oyayali se nda kɛka efi, lokasa elosɔnɔmu nd’atiteni la nda bɔkɔngɔ wa loao la elosɔlɔnɔmu la bisɔlɔnɛlɔ bosambale;
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

lokele: limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ bokitomo wa bofoka oyaamamaka la limiki lifi mbo— ¿Ndai aondu nde ndoliola lokasa la ndosɔmbɔlɔ bisɔlɔnɛlɔ ya loao?
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

lokele: La angwɛnɛ boto angɔmɔi la nda use la nda nyɛlɛ la ose ya nyɛlɛ, oyasokɔkɔlɔ ndoliola lokasa, ango ko ndoticha nda loao;
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

lokele: limɔ imi lolelaka finɛ, eoka angwɛnɛ boto angɔmɔi ɛnɛli mbo aondu nde ndoliola lokasa, ango ndoticha nda loao.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

lokele: La ɔmɔi wa biange loonga lami mbo— Olelëke, tɛnɛ ngo Simba ya tukela ya Yuda, la Wili wa Dawidi asolonga ndoliola lokasa la bisɔlɔnɛlɔ ya loao.
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

lokele: La atiteni ya kɛka efi l’eba liwawi banɛi la nd’atiteni ya biange, imi lɔɛnɛ Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ oyemali omao kwa mbo aolomu nde, la ayali la baseke bosambale la baiso bosambale ebale Balimo bosambale ba Mungu ebasotomomo ko nda biese bitotina;
english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

lokele: la Inde lɔkɛ, Inde loaela lokasa nda bosamba w’olome wa Inde oyayali se nda kɛka efi.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

lokele: La ɔsɔkɔ Inde lokasa, eba liwawi banɛi, la biange litinda la anɛi lotulama so oso wa Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ, boto la boto lounda likwengu la biengo ya mbela ebitumi la liɛsɛ lia mwɛmwɛ, yengani basomboli ba ebatanu.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

lokele: La biange lochwa bɔɛlɛ boyai boko mbo— Aɛ oondu nde ndoaela lokasa la ndoliola bisɔlɔnɛlɔ ya loao, eoka waolomoko la waendolelaka Mungu bato ko la bakila baɛ, bako bato ba tukela bitotina l’eba baoi batotina ba bato la yese bitotina;
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

lokele: la ososɛl’iyo bɛkɔta la bakanga ende Mungu wasu la bekakalekesa nda biese bitoti.
english: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

lokele: Limɔ imi loticha la imi loka limiki lia bakitomo wike ebasolingekela kɛka efi, amamwito l’eba liwawi la biange la loketi loau loyala litunda lia likama la bilɛfu ya bilɛfu;
english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

lokele: iyo loonga la limiki lifi, iyo mbo— Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ oyaolomoko aondu nde ndofomo bofoka, la lifoka, la wɛli, la isosha, la tala, la lifotesi!
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

lokele: Limɔ imi loka bitoti ebikelomu, biko ebile nda use, la ono se, l’ebile ose ya nyɛlɛ, la nda balia la bitoti ebile ina, yao loonga mbo— Lifotesi la lilitesi, la tala, la bofoka, bifomoko end’Inde oyayali se nda kɛka efi la ende Wana wa Bɔkɔkɔ ko layalaya!
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!” 5:13

lokele: La eba liwawi banɛi loonga mbo— Ongoma! Limɔ biange loswaka balui se nda lisemokoli.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the 5:14 elders fell down and worshiped. 5:14

lokele: Limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ ani asɔmbɔlɔkɔ Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ ɛmɔi ya bisɔlɔnɛlɔ bosambale, la imi loka ɔmɔi w’eba liwawi banɛi ani atoonga la limiki kwa elundi, mbo— Yauku!
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

lokele: Imi lɔɛnɛ la tɛnɛ ngo punda efufu, la boto oyatalemi nda yao lounda botaliya la inde lofomo iyoyo sha lilongi, limɔ inde lokuswa okalongela wenda.
english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

lokele: Limɔ asɔmbɔlɔkɔ Inde ɛsɔlɔnɛlɔ ya imbale, imi loka ewa liwawi lia ambale ani inde loonga mbo— Yauku!
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

lokele: La punda yasi lɔtɛmwa eyetelu la boto oyatalemi nda yao lofomo isosha shɔɔnɔkɔlɔ lilatemi nda wenda mbo bato boolakaneke, la afomoko ambɔtɛ wa likama.
english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

lokele: Limɔ asɔmbɔlɔkɔ Inde ɛsɔlɔnɛlɔ ya isatɔ, imi loka ewa liwawi lia asatɔ ani inde loonga mbo— Yauku! Imi lɔɛnɛ la tɛnɛ ngo punda yindo, la oyatalemi nda yao lounda ikweelo sha bolito nda bosamba wande.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

lokele: Limɔ imi loka kwa mbo limiki, sisi y’eba liwawi banɛi, elitoonga mbo— Ikweelo sha bofonga sitokwa lofalanga lɔmɔi la tokweela tosatɔ twa bangwindi ko lofalanga lɔmɔi, nde obebesëke baita la bänä!
english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix 6:6 of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

lokele: Limɔ asɔmbɔlɔkɔ Inde esɔlɔnɛlɔ ya inɛi, imi loka limiki lia ewa liwawi lia anɛi ani inde loonga mbo— Yauku!
english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

lokele: Imi lɔɛnɛ la tɛnɛ ngo punda elafwi kwa bolyo, la oyatalemi nda yao lotomo lina liko Liwa la ngɛnɛ wa Ewelo lotutana lande la iyo lofomo isosha shokakalesa botüku wa inɛi wa wenda, ndoola bato la ambɔtɛ la londo la loo la nyama ya lokonda.
english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades 6:8 followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

lokele: Limɔ asɔmbɔlɔkɔ Inde ɛsɔlɔnɛlɔ ya bɔɔmwi; ose ya etumbelo ya lifaefi, imi lɔɛnɛ belimo ya bato ebaolomoko eoka ya lioi lia Mungu la eoka ya likambesi liau liokambekesa basi;
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

lokele: iyo loamama la limiki lifi, iyo mbo— ¿E Ngɛnɛ oyale Botanu la Wewe, otoumwaka to ko mbile yanga, angotaatel’iso njasɔ la angotakundel’iso bakila end’iyo ana ebayali nda wenda-bo?
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

lokele: Limɔ boto la boto lofomo kanjo efufu la iyo loongomo mbo bataɛumaka kɔni mbile sinyo, ko nd’akaɔlwɛkɛ loketi loa ebasangani lau, bako bɛkɔwa la bitungani ebakaolomoko kwa aolomoko imɔ ko iyo angɛnɛ.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, 6:11 who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

lokele: Limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ ani asɔmbɔlɔkɔ Inde ɛsɔlɔnɛlɔ ya liambɛ, la nyɛlɛ lotukatuka likama la liso-lia-use lowindiala kwa likunia la songe lokweelo bakila,
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

lokele: la tolonge twa use lokwaka se nda nyɛlɛ kwa atotaka bokumo baküka se ani botolɛlɛsɔmɔ ko la lofofo lofi.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

lokele: Limɔ biuse losɛnyakana kwa lokasa elosoundukolomo la föngo la besanga betotina losokolomo nda biyaelo ya yao.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

lokele: Limɔ bɛkɔta ya biese la benyafala la betoli oso ya bita, la bafoka la bato bafi la bɛkɔwa bitoti la toote imɔ, iyo loisakama nda fowa la nda batalɛ ba föngo;
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

lokele: l’ani batoonga la föngo la batalɛ mbo— Wɛlɛkɛmɛkɛ se olikolo liasu la isamelak’iso nda bɔmbɔ wa Inde oyayali se nda kɛka efi la nda efango ya Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ,
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

lokele: eoka lise lina lifi lia efango yande lisoya, limɔ ¿Ndai to atokɔkɔlɔ ndoemesana fii omao?
english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

lokele: Mbisa yaamao, imi lɔɛnɛ bakitomo banɛi bemakali nda bako banɛi ba wenda-bo la bakufesi fofo inɛi ya wenda mbo lofofo lotafofa nda nyɛlɛ, kwa nda balia, kwa nda isandu ango simɔi.
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

lokele: Limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ bokitomo wasi, oyatɛmwaka nda ɛsɔswɛlɔ ya bonyanya, ani aundi ndembe ya ɛsɔlɔnɛlɔ ya Mungu wa liwawi, la inde loamamela bakitomo banɛi la limiki lifi, bako ebakitomo ebafomoko isosha shobebekesa nyɛlɛ la balia,
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

lokele: inde mbo— Obebesëke nyɛlɛ, angoko balia, angoko tosandu, ani tokasɔlɔnɛsi bɛkɔwa ya Mungu wasu la ndembe nda toangala twau.
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

lokele: Limɔ imi loka loketi loa ebasɔlɔnɔmɔkɔ la ndembe, loko bilɛfu mia la bilɛfu kama inɛi la inɛi, bako eba tukela bitoti ya bana ba Isalaele.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

lokele: Eba tukela ya Yuda ebasɔlɔnɔmɔkɔ la ndembe, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale, Eba tukela ya Lubena, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Eba tukela ya Gada, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale.
english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

lokele: Eba tukela ya Asela, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Eba tukela ya Nafatali, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Eba tukela ya Manase, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale.
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

lokele: Eba tukela ya Simeona, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Eba tukela ya Lewi, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Eba tukela ya Isaka, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale.
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

lokele: Eba tukela ya Sebulone, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Eba tukela ya Yosefa, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Eba tukela ya Benyamina, ko bilɛfu liu la imbale. Etanda ya likama ya tukela bitoti ya wenda-bo
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

lokele: Mbisa yaamao, imi loticha la tɛnɛ ngo ekuke ya likama eyetikɔkɔlɛ ndotangomo la boto angɔmɔi, bato ba biese bitoti l’eba tukela la kanda ya bato l’eba baoi batoti, iyo loemakala oso wa kɛka efi l’oso wa Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ la bawataka kanjo bifufu la bakanga ba batoko nda besamba yau.
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

lokele: La iyo loamamaka la limiki lifi, iyo mbo— Liuwesi lisoomana la Mungu wasu Oyayali se nda kɛka efi la imɔ ko la Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

lokele: La bakitomo batoti ebalingeli kɛka efi la biange, l’eba liwawi banɛi, iyo lokwa biɔmbɔ se oso wa kɛka efi la iyo losemokola Mungu,
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

lokele: iyo loonga mbo— Eingo ko, lifoti la tala la wɛlï la kelekele la lilitesi la bofoka la isosha biyaleke la Mungu wasu ko layalaya! Ongoma!
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

lokele: Limɔ ɔmɔi w’eba biange lofela’mi, inde mbo— ¿Bende bandai to ebasowataka kanjo bifufu la basekwi nde l’onima?
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

lokele: La imi loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, Aɛ nd’aluwi. Limɔ Inde loonga lami mbo— Eba bende ebasosekwa nda bifembi bifi la basosoola kanjo yau la basofufola yao nda bakila ba Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ.
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. 7:14 They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

lokele: Eokao bayali nde oso wa kɛka efi ya Mungu, la batosemokola Inde la löwa la ocho nda Ndakɔ yande la Inde Oyayali se nda kɛka efi eobyamelak’iyo.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

lokele: Batiokek’imɔ tosiyɛ liasi, ango ko yɛmɛ yomwa, la löwa la efanga ya loao bitiomanelek’iyo,
english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

lokele: eoka Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ Oyayali nd’atiteni ya kɛka efi eyalaka nde Botingani wau la ɛkɛsɛk’iyo ko nda tosolo twa balia ba loiko, la Mungu angɛnɛ eɔmbɔkɔlɔkɔ foo bitoti nda baiso bau.
english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

lokele: Limɔ asɔmbɔlɔkɔ Inde ɛsɔlɔnɛlɔ ya bosambale, Use loyala ko hai ko la botüku wa saa ɛmɔi,
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

lokele: la imi lɔɛnɛ bakitomo bosambale ebemakali oso wa Mungu, limɔ tofonge bosambale lofaefomo iyo.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

lokele: La bokitomo wasi loya la inde loemala tina la etumbelo ya lifaefi ani aundi efechelo ya mwɛmwɛ la inde lofomo mwɛmwɛ wike ya liɛsɛ mbo atambeke yao amamwito la basomboli ba ebatanu nda efechelo ya mbela eyayali oso wa kɛka efi;
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

lokele: la bolilya wa mwɛmwɛ lolilaka ende Mungu eoka ya basomboli ba ebatanu ani bososekwela lingasa lia bokitomo.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo lotola efechelo ya mwɛmwɛ, inde lotumesa yao la bösä wa efechelo la inde lokushaka wao se nda nyɛlɛ; limɔ yaaka bilundi la bamiki ba tobalibali, la nyɛlɛ lotukatuka.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

lokele: Limɔ bakitomo bosambale ebaundi tofonge bosambale, iyo lokomiana iyo angɛnɛ ndooma tofonge.
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

lokele: La ewa oso looma ifonge, limɔ basasɛ ba mbula la bösä ebisosɔbiɔmɔ la bakila, yao lotɔnɔ se nda nyɛlɛ, limɔ botüku wa isatɔ wa nyɛlɛ loseka la botüku wa isatɔ wa tosandu loseka la chwingi chwesi tototi loseka fɛɛ.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, 8:7 and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

lokele: La bokitomo wa ambale looma ifonge, limɔ yeka kwa löngo lofi elosoana la bösä lokushomo nda balia, la botüku wa isato wa balia lokinjwa kwa bakila;
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

lokele: la botüku wa isatɔ wa yao ebiyali nda balia, ebiyali la liwawi, yao lowa, la botüku wa isatɔ wa biatɔ losɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔkɔ.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

lokele: La bokitomo wa asatɔ looma ifonge, limɔ ilonge sifi esiafyaka kwa imwɛli lokwa se, la shao lokwa se nda botüku wa isatɔ wa baande la tosolo two balia;
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

lokele: la lina lia ilonge sina lisotangomo mbo Samba. Limɔ botüku wa isatɔ wa balia lokinjwa samba la bato wike lowa la balia eoka basokinjwa ko bololo.
english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

lokele: La bokitomo wa anɛi looma ifonge, limɔ botüku wa isatɔ wa liso lia use lotufesomo, la botüku wa isatɔ wa songe, la botüku wa isatɔ wa tolonge, mbo botüku wa isatɔ wa twao botufeke ko la lilima la mbo botüku wa isatɔ wa löwa botaana la songe ko la ocho lisanga.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

lokele: Limɔ imi loticha, la imi loka elongo eyesoungwa nd’atiteni ya use la se, yao loamama la limiki lifi mbo— Aeko, aeko, aeko ende ebasoyala nda wenda, eoka ya baoma basatɔ basi ebakaomeke bakitomo basatɔ nda tofonge!
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, 8:13 flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wa bɔɔmwi looma ifonge, la imi lɔɛnɛ ilonge esiakwaka se nda nyɛlɛ; la inde lofomo lofungola loa liöndo eliti la tunga;
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

lokele: la inde loliola liöndo eliti la tunga; limɔ bolilya lokuswaka nda liao, kwa bolilya wa litumbo lifi la liso lia use la buse imɔ lotufaka eoka ya bolilya wa liöndo.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a 9:2 burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

lokele: Limɔ bakelele lokuswaka nda bolilya, bao lomelana nda wenda la bafomoko isosha kwa shao sha tomamowa;
english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

lokele: la twao lofomo boimo mbo batabebesa bangala, ango ko chwingi, ango ko tosandu, ko bato kongo ebatisɔlɔnɛsɔmɔ la ndembe ya Mungu nda toangala twau.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

lokele: La bafomoko isosha shokekes’iyo biale ko tengai bɔɔmwi kongo, inga shoola bato; nde wale ewokes’iyo balomboki wayalaka kwa wao wa imamowa esitoicha boto.
english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

lokele: La nda bacho ana, bato belukaka liwa nde batiɛnɛkɛ liao, la beyalaka la yɛmɛ yowa, kongo ko liwa likwakelak’iyo otili.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

lokele: Bakelele lɔɛnɛlɛ kwa punda ebisotonjomo okanana bita la nda betö iyo lowata yeka kwa toyoyo twa mbela la biɔmbɔ yau loyala kwa biɔmbɔ ya balomboki;
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

lokele: la swee yau loyala kwa swee ya batomali la bainyo bau kwa bainyo ba simba;
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

lokele: la mboso ya bekükü yau loyala kwa betaka ya yeto la elundi ya bafafu bau loyala kwa elundi ya bilutelo ya punda wike ani bitoengaka mangu okakɛ bita;
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

lokele: iyo loyala la bekali kwa tomamowa la bainyo nda yao la bofoka wau wobebesa balomboki ko tengai bɔɔmwi loyala ko nda bekali.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

lokele: Bale la Bɔkɔta wokakales’iyo, ako bokitomo wa liöndo eliti la tunga, lina liande nda lioi lia BaYuda mbo Abadona, la nda lioi lia BaHela mbo Apolona, litina mbo Bosɛɛsɛli.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, 9:11 but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”. 9:11

lokele: Aeko, liömä lia oso lisoeta! Toka kɔni, baömä bambale batoya mbisa!
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wa liambɛ looma ifonge, lamao imi loka limiki lisokuswa nda baseke ba etumbelo ya lifaefi ya mbela eyeyali oso wa Mungu;
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

lokele: limiki loonga la bokitomo wa liambɛ oyaundi ifonge mbo— Faikolaka bakitomo banɛi ebakandakomu nda liande lifi liko Eufalate.
english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

lokele: Limɔ bakitomo banɛi ana ebatakomiomoko ndoumbakela ko saa-ye, la lise-li, la tengai-ye, la mwaka-bo, iyo lofaikolomo mbo boleke botüku wa isatɔ wa balomboki.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

lokele: Loketi loa ebananaka bita ebatalemaka nda punda loko batinda ba batinda ba bilɛfu, imi loka loketi loau.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. 9:16 I heard the number of them.

lokele: Nda lɔɛnɛsɔ, imi lɔɛnɛ punda la ebatalemaka nda yao, kwa mbo bawataka betaka bitelu kwa bösä la boele, la betö ya punda loyala kwa betö ya simba la bösä la bolilya la boele lokuswaka nda bɛnɔkɔ yau;
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

lokele: la botüku wa isatɔ wa balomboki loolakomo ko la baömä-ba basatɔ, bako bösä la bolilya la boele eyakuswaka nda bɛnɔkɔ yau.
english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

lokele: Eoka bofoka wa punda bole ko nda bɛnɔkɔ yau la nda bekali yau, eoka bekali yau loyala kwa njɔ ebile la betö eyau, la bitobebesa balomboki ko la yao.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

lokele: Bato ebasandeloko se, ebatiaolokomoko ko la baömä-ba, batiakalanganaka loasɔ loa bekeeli ya besamba yau, batiangomachaka lisemoli lia belimo ibe la bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu ebisotulomo nda mbela la bieto ya pata la besongo, l’ebisokwɛtɔmɔ nda batalɛ la tosandu, ebitikɔkɔlɛ ango ndoka ango ndɔɛnɛ kwa ndokɛndɛkɛndɛ;
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

lokele: la batiakalanganaka loasɔ loa baoli bau boolaka bato, ango ko basoo bau la bilëfë yau la wiya wau.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, 9:21 their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

lokele: Limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ bokitomo wasi wa ofoka ani atosulwa se nda buse, inde lolingelomo la litumba la bonama nda botö wande la bɔmbɔ wande loyala kwa löwa la bakolo bande kwa bakole ba bösä.
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

lokele: La inde loyala la ikakasa esiliolomu nda lingasa liande, la inde lota litindi liande lia olome nda balia, la elia wali nda boili.
english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

lokele: Limɔ inde loamama la limiki lifi kwa atoulaula kwa simba; la amamak’inde ongoma, limɔ bilundi osambale lolundalunda l’ebau bamiki.
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

lokele: Alundaka bilundi osambale, yasiaka osɔnɔ lokasa limɔ imi loka limiki nda use elisoonga mbo— Sɔlɔnɛsɛkɛ yao ebisoonga bilundi osambale, osɔnɛ̈kɛ yao nda lokasa.
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo oyɛnɛkɛ’mi ani emesani nda balia la nda boili, inde loila bosamba wande w’olome likolo, limɔ inde lotinya ekanɔ ko la Inde oyayali la loiko loa layalaya, oyakelaka buse la ebiyali nda wao, la wenda la ebiyali nda wao, la balia imɔ ko la ebiyali nda bao, mbo angwɛnɛ imɔ fofe youmwaka,
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

lokele: kangä mbo, ani akaongeke bokitomo ko la limiki lia ifonge, limɔ njasɔ ebiisomu la Mungu, yao kɔɔlwa kwa atelak’Inde batɔndɔli bande boeki.
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

lokele: Limɔ limiki eliokaka’mi nda use, imi loka liao ko liasi, liaongaka mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okaaela ikakasa esiliolomu nda lingasa lia bokitomo oyemali nda balia la nda boili.
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

lokele: Limɔ imi lɔkɛ ende bokitomo, imi loonga lande mbo afeke’mi ikakasa-si. La inde loonga lami mbo— Aelaka shao la mɛlɛkɛ shao bokekenu, sitoyala la bololo nda sɔlɔ yaɛ kongo ko nda bɔnɔkɔ waɛ sitoyala la lɔɛtɛ kwa eloa wee.
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

lokele: La imi loaela ikakasa sina nda lingasa lia bokitomo, imi lomɛlɛ shao bokekenu, la nda bɔnɔkɔ wami shao lookana la lɔɛtɛ kwa eloa wee, nde alaka’mi shao, sɔlɔ yami lokwelo bololo.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

lokele: Limɔ imi loongomo mbo— Lole loaɛ mbo otɔndɔlɛkɛ liasi loasɔ loa bato wike la tukela wike la baoi ba bato la bɛkɔta wike.
english: They 10:11 told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

lokele: Limɔ yafomoko ifende eshaaka kwa ikweelo, la imi loongomo mbo— Emalaka la kweelaka Ndakɔ ya Mungu la etumbelo ya lifaefi la loketi loa bato ebatosemola Mungu omao,
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

lokele: la machaka balɛlɛ lousa loa Ndakɔ ya Mungu, okweelëke bao, eoka basofaefomo bato ba tukela ya wenda la batomatekela bokenge botanu ko tengai kama inɛi la imbale.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

lokele: La yefaefaka banangoli bami bambale isosha shonangola la betɔndɔkɔlɔkɔ ko bacho ɛlɛfu ɛmɔi la mia imbale la kama liambɛ, ani batowataka ko bakunia.
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

lokele: Eba bende tosandu tombale twa tuma twa baita la bitalielo ya päka bimbale eyemesani oso wa Ngɛnɛ wa wenda,
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

lokele: la boto ɛlɛmbɛ ndobebesa iyo, ani bösä botokuswaka nda bɛnɔkɔ yau la botofecha biyani lau; boto ɛlɛmbɛ ndobebesa iyo, aondu nde ndoolomo ko ongoma.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

lokele: Eba bende l’isosha sholinjaka use mbo mbula etatɔnɔ ko la bacho ebatotɔndɔkɔl’iyo; bende l’isosha shokindola balia ko bakila la ndoomaka wenda la baömä batoti ko mbile la mbile, kwa akalɛmbɛk’iyo.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

lokele: Limɔ akasileke iyo linangoli liau, nyama eyetokuswa nda liondo eliti la tunga atonana lau bita la atolongel’iyo, la atoolak’iyo;
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

lokele: limɔ belyo yau beyalaka nde nda lɔmbɔ loa bokenge bofi ebosotangomo nda inango sha njasɔ ya bolimo mbo Sodomo la Ejipeto, olo olomoko imɔ ko Ngɛnɛ wau nda lieka.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

lokele: Bato ba biese wike la tukela wike la eba baoi wike la eba wenda bototi, betichaka belyo yau bacho basatɔ la botüku, la batofeka mbo belyo ina betaombomo nda kito;
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

lokele: la ebatoyalaka nda wenda belaomalaka loasɔ loau, belainaka bisha la belafaekefana bafi, ko l’eoka mbo e-batɔndɔli-ba bambale bokesaka bato ebayali nda wenda ko wale finɛ.
english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

lokele: Limɔ mbisa ya bacho basatɔ la botüku, luli loa liwawi, eloa Mungu angɛnɛ, loao lɔɔtɛl’iyo la iyo loemala nda batindi bau, la bɔwa wa likama lokwelo ebɛnɛk’iyo.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

lokele: Limɔ iyo ana loka limiki lifi nda use elitoonga lau mbo— Lilaka ono likolo! La iyo lolila likolo nda litumba la biyani lau lɔɛnɛk’iyo.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

lokele: Limɔ ko la mbile-ao nyɛlɛ lotukatuka finɛ la botüku wa liu wa bokenge lowɛlɛmɛ se; bato bilɛfu bosambale lowa nda lotukatuko loa nyɛlɛ la bato ebatikelaka lokwelo bɔwa la iyo loinela Mungu wa Use.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

lokele: Aeko, liömä lia ambale lisoeta! Toka kɔni, liömä lia asatɔ litoya la mangu!
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wa osambale looma ifonge, limɔ bamiki bafi lokomoko nda use, ebaongaka mbo— Likakalesi lia wenda-bo lisoyela elia Ngɛnɛ wasu la elia Masiya wande, la Inde ekakalesaka wao ko layalaya.
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

lokele: Limɔ biange kama imbale la inɛi ebayalaka se oso wa Mungu nda kɛka yau, iyo loswaka biɔmbɔ yau se, iyo losemokola Mungu, iyo loonga mbo—
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

lokele: E Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa Bofoka bototina, Oyayali la Oyayalaka, tosofaef’Aɛ kelekele eoka osoaela bofoka waɛ bofi la osoakola ndokakalesa wenda.
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, 11:17 because you have taken your great power and reigned.

lokele: Eba tukela ya wenda basomaka, nde eyaɛ efango loya, la mbile yoataka njasɔ y’ebasowa esoiyela, la mbile yokaela bɛkɔwa yaɛ bondanda wau, bako bɛtɔndɔli l’ebatanu, l’ebasolitesa lina liaɛ, l’ebakɛkɛ, l’ebafi lisanga, la mbile yosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ ebatosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ wenda-bo.
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

lokele: Limɔ Ndakɔ ya Mungu eyele nda Use loliolomo la kwokwolo ya Ngɛla yande lɔɛnɛlɛ nda Ndakɔ yande; limɔ tobalibali la bamiki ba bilundi lɔɛnɛlɛ la nyɛlɛ lotukatuka la mbula ya basasɛ bafi lotɔnɔ.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

lokele: Limɔ esisho ya likama lɔɛnɛlɛ nda Use, botomali oyalingelomu la liso lia use, la tengai ose ya batindi bande, la iyoyo sha tolonge liu la tombale nda botö wande.
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

lokele: Botomali loyala la liɛmɛ elisoya lisɔlɛ la inde loomaoma la toelo la bomusi woota.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

lokele: Limɔ esisho yasi lɔɛnɛlɛ nda Use; tɛnɛ, likilɔ lifi litelu eliyali la betö osambale la baseke liu la beyoyo bosambale ya bɛkɔta nda betö yande.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

lokele: La bokali wande lɔɔmbɔlɔ botüku wa isatɔ wa tolonge twa use la wao lokusha twao se nda nyɛlɛ. Limɔ likilɔ loemala oso wa botomali oyayali oko tina loota, mbo, akaotek’inde, limɔ inde komɛlɛ wana wande.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

lokele: Limɔ botomali loota wana otolome oyakakakaleseke tukela bitoti ko la isosola sha yeto. La wana wande lɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ okakɛsɔmɔ ko ende Mungu olo nda kɛka efi yande.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

lokele: Limɔ botomali lokwa otili nda liɔmbɛlɛ olo ayali elela eyesotonjelomo inde ko la Mungu mbo bakukiek’inde omao bacho ɛlɛfu ɛmɔi la mia imbale la kama liambɛ. Mikaele la bakitomo bande lonanaka la Likilɔ
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

lokele: Limɔ bonano wayalaka nda Use, Mikaele la bakitomo bande lonanaka la Likilɔ; la Likilɔ la eyande bakitomo lonanaka,
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

lokele: nde batialongaka la batiafomoko imɔ elela nda Use.
english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

lokele: Limɔ Likilɔ lifi, eko njɔ ya kwalakwala oyasotomo lina liko Bowanjeli la Satana, oyatolimbaka wenda bototi, inde lokushakomo ko nda nyɛlɛ amamwito la bakitomo bande.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

lokele: Limɔ imi loka limiki lifi nda Use, eliaongaka mbo— Kwani bisoya to liuwesi la bofoka la yakakaelo ya Mungu wasu la isosha sha Masiya wande eoka Bowanjeli wa bitungani yasu asokushomo se, ako inde oyasowanjekel’iyo oso wa Mungu wasu ko la löwa la ocho.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

lokele: Basolongel’inde ko l’eoka ya bakila ba Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ la eoka ya lioi lia likambesi liau, la losamɔ loau losamaka liwawi liau angɛnɛ lotiakufesak’iyo ndowa.
english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

lokele: Eokao, omakalaka, Buse la ino ebasoyala nda wao! Aeko wale end’ino ba wenda la balia, eoka Bowanjeli asosulwel’ino se la efango ya likama, eoka aluwi nde mbo akoyali la fofe ko la mbile sinyo kongo! Likilɔ loengaka botomali la bana bande
english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ Likilɔ mbo asokushomo nda nyɛlɛ, inde lokakongola otomali oyaoti wana otolome.
english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

lokele: Nde botomali lofomo bafafu bambale ba elongo efi mbo akweke botili nda liɔmbɛlɛ, ko nda elela yande olo atokukiomo inde ko mbile bisatɔ la botüku wa mbile, ndosɛnyana la njɔ omao.
english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

lokele: Limɔ Likilɔ lowɛlɛkɛ botomali balia kwa liande angɛnɛ nda bɔnɔkɔ wande, ombisa ya botomali, mbo balia balindesek’inde kwa fela.
english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

lokele: Kongo ko nyɛlɛ losunga botomali la nyɛlɛ loasola bɔnɔkɔ wande, la inde lomɛlɛkɛ balia ebawɛlɛkɛ Likilɔ nda ewande bɔnɔkɔ.
english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

lokele: Limɔ Likilɔ losomela botomali, inde losekwa omao okananaka la bana ebamɔi bande bita, bako ebatolitekesa bikela ya Mungu l’ebatokɔkɔmɛlɛ likambesi lia Yesu.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, 12:17 who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

lokele: Limɔ yɛnɛkɛ nyama eyaeswaka nda balia bafi, eyali la baseke liu la betö bosambale la nda baseke awati beyoyo liu ya bɛkɔta la nda betö baina ba lifekwani bayali.
english: Then I stood 13:1 he stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

lokele: La nyama eyɛnɛkɛ’mi yaaka kwa ngɔi la batindi bande bayali kwa batindi ba nyama efi la bɔnɔkɔ wande boyali kwa bɔnɔkɔ wa simba. La Likilɔ lof’inde bofoka wande la kɛka efi yande la isosha sifi.
english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

lokele: La ɔmɔi wa betö osambale lɔɛnɛlɛ kwa mbo waswomoko lifwa lia liwa nde liswa liwau losäsesomo sasosaso limɔ wenda bototi lotuta mbisa ya nyama la limwaali,
english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

lokele: la iyo losemokola Likilɔ eoka afaka nyama isosha shande limɔ iyo losemokola nyama, iyo mbo— ¿Ndai engani la nyama-ye, la ndai atokɔkɔlɔ ndonana lande?
english: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

lokele: La nyama lofomo bɔnɔkɔ woonga baoi b’ifaala la lifekwani la inde lofomo imɔ isosha shokela njasɔ yande ko tengai kama inɛi la imbale;
english: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

lokele: limɔ nyama loasola bɔnɔkɔ wande ko ndofekwana la Mungu la lina liande, la Ndakɔ ya Mungu la ebasoyala olo nda Use.
english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

lokele: Inde lofomo imɔ ko isosha shonana bita la ebatanu la ndolongel’iyo la isosha shokakalesa bekulü bitoti ya bato, la baoi batoti la tukela bitoti nda wenda.
english: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

lokele: Batotina ebayali nda wenda-bo batosemol’inde, bako boto la boto oyatitomo lina ko nda baakowelo nda lokasa loa loiko loa Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ Oyaolomoko.
english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

lokele: Boto eyala la litoi, okeke to!
english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

lokele: Boto eondu nde ndoindomo, ambo atoindomo to; boto eola boto wasi, ambo aondu nde ndoolomo la ambɔtɛ. Nda loasɔ-lo likɔkɔmɛlɛ la liimeli lia ebatanu bitɔɛnɛlɛ.
english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. 13:10 Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

lokele: Limɔ yɛnɛkɛ nyama yasi eyaeswaka nda nyɛlɛ, inde loyala la baseke bambale kwa eba efembeli ya bɔkɔkɔ, nde limiki liande loyala kwa elia Likilɔ.
english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

lokele: Inde lofomo isosha sha nyama ya oso la inde lokakalesa bato oso wa nyama ena, mbo wenda bototi la bato ebayali ina basemokoleke nyama ena ya oso oyaaka la liswa liwau eliasäsesomoko sasosaso.
english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

lokele: Inde atokelaka bisisho ya likama biko ndoeshaka ango bosä ono se ko nda use fololo nda baiso ba bato;
english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

lokele: la atolimbaka ebayali nda wenda-bo ko la bisisho ebitokel’inde ko la isosha esifomu inde nda baiso ba nyama ya oso, la atoongaka la bato ebayali nda wenda-bo mbo bakeleke bɔfɔnɔ wa nyama ena oyaswomoko lifwa la ambɔtɛ la oyakoyali la liwawi.
english: He deceives my own 13:14 people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

lokele: La isosha shafomoko ende nyama shofaefa bɔfɔnɔ ona wa nyama ko luli, mbo bɔfɔnɔ imɔ aongeke la mbo ebatisemokole bɔfɔnɔ wa nyama baolomoko.
english: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

lokele: Atowachaka batoti, ko ebafi l’ebakɛkɛ, la bafoka l’ebatouwe, la toote la bɛkɔwa, ko chapa nda bosamba wa olome la nda liangala lia boto la boto,
english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

lokele: la mbo angwɛnɛ boto wɔkɔkɔlɔ ndosomba yeka, kwa ndoungesa yeka, sakolo ngo ko asoyala la chapa eko lina lia nyama ena ango ko loketi loa lina liande.
english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

lokele: Elo lole loasɔ loa wɛlï; inde oyayali la liluwani atangeke to loketi loa nyama, eoka lole ngo loketi loa bolomboki, la loketi loande lole mia liambɛ la kama liambɛ la liambɛ.
english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

lokele: Limɔ imi loticha la tɛnɛ ngo Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ emali nda löngo loko Siona, la amamwito lande bato bilɛfu mia la bilɛfu kama inɛi la bilɛfu inɛi ebasotomo lina liande la lina lia Sango wande nda toangala twau.
english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

lokele: Limɔ imi loka limiki litosekwa nda Use, kwa elundi ya tolimo twa balia, kwa elundi ya likama, la kwa tongololi twa liomi lia bakwengu.
english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

lokele: Limɔ iyo lochwa bɔɛlɛ boyai oso wa kɛka efi la oso wa eba liwawi banɛi la oso wa biange. Boto angɔmɔi kokɔkɔlɔ ndoeka bɔɛlɛ ona, sakolo ngo ko eba bilɛfu mia la bilɛfu kama inɛi la bilɛfu inɛi, bako ebaendolomoko nda wenda-bo.
english: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

lokele: Bende ebatiakwanaka la batomali bokili eoka baitosɔngɔ; bende ebatotutaka Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ l’olo l’olo akakɛndɛk’Inde. Bende ebasoendolomo ende balomboki, bayaleke kwa buka wa eula ewukamesomoko ende Mungu la ende Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ,
english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

lokele: la lilimbakeli litiokomoko nda bɛnɔkɔ yau la bati ango la litwanelo. Bakitomo lotomomo tomo nda wenda bototina la wɛndi ende bato
english: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless. 14:5

lokele: Limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ bokitomo wasi oyatoungwaka atiteni ya use la se, la afomoko Mboli Ilau ya loiko mbo anangoeleke bato abasoyala nda wenda la tukela bitoti la befindi bitoti, la ende bato ba baoi batoti;
english: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

lokele: inde loonga la limiki lifi mbo— Wangaka Mungu la faefak’Inde tala, eoka saa ya liatakeli liande esoya; la semokolak’Inde oyakelaka use la se, la eliya efi ya balia la tosolo lisanga.
english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wasi, ewa ambale, lotutel’inde, inde loonga mbo— Bosoukwa! Bosoukwa, boko Babilona, bokenge bofi ebosomwesa bato ba tukela bitoti bänä ba bolenge wa bolëfë wande!
english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wasi, ewa asatɔ, lotutel’inde, inde loonga la limiki lifi mbo— Boto esemola nyama-ye la bɔfɔnɔ wande, la ewachomo chapa nda iangala ango nda bosamba wande,
english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

lokele: inde nd’atomwaka imɔ ko bänä ba bolengi wa Mungu ebasowɛlɔmɔ ko bao, angwɛnɛ ango balia, nda kɔpɔ ya efango yande. Limɔ eokesomoko wale finɛ ko la bosä la boele, oso wa bakitomo batanu la oso wa Wana wa bɔkɔkɔ.
english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

lokele: Limɔ bolilya wa likongolomu liau botolilaka olo nda use ko layalaya la baitwɛuma la löwa la bocho, bako ebasosemokola nyama ena la bɔfɔɔnɔ wande, l’ebasɔɔlɔ chapa ya lina liande.
english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

lokele: Nda loasɔ-lo ɛnɛkɛ to likɔkɔmɛlɛ lia ebatolitesa ndola ya Mungu la liimeli lia Yesu!
english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

lokele: Limɔ imi loka limiki nda use elitoonga mbo— Sɔnɔkɔ mbo ebakaweke ani basoyala la Ngɛnɛ wasu, bende ngo ko la limɛngɔ. Bolimo asoonga imɔ ko mbo— Eingo ko, mbo batɛkumeke kɔni nda bonui wa bakuwa bau, eoka bekeeli yau bitotutakana lau. Wana wa Boto lotwaka eula ya wenda-bo
english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”

lokele: Limɔ imi loticha la tɛnɛ ngo lifita lifufu, la oyayali se nda lifita loyala kwa bɔfɔnɔ wa Wana wa Boto; nda botö wande inde lowata boyoyo wa mbela la nda bosamba wande inde lounda chaka ya lowelo.
english: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, Daniel 7:13 having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wasi lokuswa nda Einelo ya Mungu la inde loamamel’Inde oyayali se nda lifita ko la limiki lifi, mbo— Ilyaka chaka yaɛ, twaka eula, eoka mbile yotwa esoya la eula ya wenda-bo esotela.
english: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

lokele: Limɔ Inde oyayali se nda lifita, loilyaka chaka yande nda wenda la eula ya wenda lotwomo fɛɛ.
english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wasi lokuswa nda Einelo ya Mungu nda Use, la inde imɔ lounda chaka ya lowelo.
english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

lokele: La bokitomo wasi lokuswa nda etumbelo ya lifaefi, inde loyala la isosha nda bösä la inde loamamel’Inde oyaundi chaka ya lowelo, la limiki lifi, mbo— Ilyaka chaka yaɛ ya lowelo la twaka bekima ya tuma twa elanga ya wenda, eoka tuma twa wao tosotelatela.
english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo loilyaka chaka yande nda wenda la inde lotwaka tuma twa elanga ya wenda la inde lokushaka twao nda liyöndo lifi liotwangela tuma twa efango ya Mungu;
english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

lokele: limɔ etwangelo ya tuma lomatekelomoko ko omolo nda liko lia bokenge, la bakila lokuswaka nda etwangelo, bao loelwa helo ko nda kingo ya punda, ndolindesa nyɛlɛ esika kwa tokweelo ɛlɛfu ɛmɔi la mia liambɛ.
english: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia. 14:20

lokele: Limɔ imi lɔɛnɛ esisho yasi nda Use, esisho efi yomwaalomo; bakitomo bosambale loyala la baömä bosambale ba liili, eoka efango ya Mungu etosilela oko nda bao.
